def make_patch_image(corner='tl', patch_size=3, patch_type='white'):

    # Start with a gray image (128)

    # 1 pixel in from corner
    if corner == 'tl':  # top-left

    elif corner == 'tr':  # top-right
        r, c = 1, 32 - 1 - patch_size
    elif corner == 'bl':  # bottom-left

    elif corner == 'br':  # bottom-right

    if patch_type == 'white':
        patch_val = 255
    elif patch_type == 'black':
        patch_val = 0
    elif patch_type == 'checkerboard':
        patch = torch.zeros(patch_size, patch_size, dtype=torch.uint8)
